about: The Workbench icons of the Snipes drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own: a corner of the maze with a snipe and the player, in the game's characters and CGA colours, drawn by amiga/tools/make_icon_art.py with the port's font (art/snipes.png). Snipes-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Snipes.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Snipes.info. Replays.info is the drawer the game records its replays in.
